detail.longDescription:
V2Lite VPN is a free, fast and secure one-tap VPN for iPhone and iPad. Connect with one tap and protect your online privacy on Wi-Fi hotspots and mobile data. No account, no sign-up and no setup: just open the app and tap Connect.

FREE VPN WITH ONE-TAP CONNECT
- One tap to connect to a fast VPN server
- Smart server selection: V2Lite automatically picks the fastest server with the lowest latency
- Stable, high-speed VPN for browsing, streaming videos, social apps, gaming and video calls
- Free to use: watch a few short ads to add VPN time to your session, and choose how long you want to stay connected

SECURE & PRIVATE VPN
- Encrypts your internet traffic to keep your data safe on public Wi-Fi, home networks and cellular data
- Hides your IP address and gives you a virtual location
- Strict no-logs policy: we do not record the websites you visit or what you do online
- No registration and no personal information required

ADVANCED VPN PROTOCOLS, ZERO SETUP
V2Lite uses advanced protocols inside the app, including VLESS, VMess (V2Ray / Xray), Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2 and TUIC, to deliver fast and reliable connections even on unstable networks. Everything is handled automatically in the app, so there is nothing for you to configure.

GLOBAL VPN SERVERS
- Use "Fastest free" for automatic selection, or open the server list to choose a VPN location yourself
- Live upload and download traffic stats while you are connected
- Remaining VPN time is shown right on the connect button

V2LITE PREMIUM: UNLIMITED VPN
Upgrade to V2Lite Premium for the best VPN experience:
- Unlimited VPN connection time
- No ads
- Access to premium high-speed servers

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, available weekly or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings at any time.

Download V2Lite VPN, the simple, super fast and free one-tap VPN, and enjoy a safer, more private internet.
